scope: Public/generated discovery and decision comparison before costly bank experiments

profiles.admission: Declared independent units, graph assumptions and appropriate CI test or score
profiles.outputs: CPDAG or declared candidate plus test/score/search settings

profiles.admission: Distinct functional/noise/density assumptions and numerical acceptance
profiles.outputs: Candidate or model with raw/thresholded weights, constraints and diagnostics

profiles.admission: Selection and hidden-variable graph class, method-specific oracle/sample premises
profiles.outputs: Exact endpoint object with weaker RFCI interpretation where applicable

profiles.admission: Physical lag, subjects, masks, availability clock, horizon and sampling law
profiles.outputs: Declared temporal graph or supplied-model result; no automatic effect calibration

candidates: UTIGSP-related method as a distinct profile
profiles.admission: Known/unknown targets and mechanism semantics admitted separately; unchanged mechanisms and sampling premises
profiles.outputs: Interventional graph class/target conclusions under exact method assumptions

fixed_examples.anchor: Cancellation, equivalent chains, selection and horizon/decision references

matched_comparison: Same admitted observation experiment and target for comparable methods; explicit extra assumptions for alternatives.
diagnostics: Regime masks and unknown target refusal
Target effect and conditional decision loss
rights_and_costs: Retain package-specific adoption/bridge/port/reference/rejection choices; include preparation, runtime, diagnosis, review and maintenance.
public_data_role: Permitted public covariates/calendars can inform generated examples; they do not supply unobserved intervention truth.
known_next_routes: Implement one admitted generated comparison per profile after environment/rights closure.
Acquire and inspect remaining original-source candidates without blocking ready profiles.
Compare finite-sample graph retention and effect/decision consequences under a frozen fresh protocol.
unknown_or_external: No general guarantee for arbitrary nonlinear/latent/dependent families.
Bank assignment truth, feasible interventions, precision/loss and actual costs require later owners.
